evidence.detail: colors_html() builds and returns a raw HTML string containing <div class="mana-bar"> and nested <span> elements
d.colors_safe = colors_html(d.colors, d.colored_symbols) — HTML string stored on deck objects
result.colors_safe = colors_html(colors, colored_symbols) — same HTML emitted in the archetypes2 JSON API response
mana-bar uses a fixed calc(18rem / 20) height, confirming the fixed-height complaint is still present

triage.notes: Two related sub-problems: (1) API sends HTML blobs instead of data (colors + fractions), breaking API consumers; (2) the mana-bar component has a hardcoded 18px height. Fixing either requires changes across prepare.py, api.py, templates, and CSS — well beyond easy-fix scope.
